Surprise announcement! 🤍

Video

🚨SPECIAL REPORT🚨 Trump Week One. 
Go watch my 30 minute DEEP dive special report on the flood of executive orders Trump signed this week. 
I know it’s easy to become overwhelmed because there are so many of them. But this report may help. 
youtu.be/P8N2UAxqJKY?...

In a surprise twist, President-elect Trump filed his own amicus brief to the Supreme Court asking the justices to put a STAY on the TikTok ban so he can decide what to do with it when he takes office. 
www.youtube.com/watch?v=DqdV...

Here is the US Government's opening argument to the Supreme Court.
www.youtube.com/watch?v=uazx...

Here is TikTok's opening argument to the Supreme Court.
www.youtube.com/watch?v=6Nm_...

It has been a DAY. I spent all day reading multiple Supreme Court opening briefs and amicus briefs regarding the TikTok ban and the law that established it.
Standby for a thread with all the information you should know.
Merry Christmas everyone ❤️🎄
Buon Natale sister!!! Glad to see you here too.  🎄❤️

President Biden abandoned his efforts to forgive federal student loans. This comes after several GOP states sued, the courts blocked his plans & the Trump administration says they'll kill the efforts. 

www.youtube.com/watch?v=1TAm...
I appreciate that. Thanks for being here too.

TikTok's lawyers give us a game plan for how they are going to argue in front of the Supreme Court to strike down the TikTok ban on January 19th. More in this video. 
www.youtube.com/watch?v=svx3...

We are on the brink of a government shutdown. How did we get here? This video explains. 
www.youtube.com/watch?v=Oouv...

Senators release scathing report about the BILLIONS of dollars 5 airlines have collected in just seat fees and baggage fees. Then hauled the execs down to Capitol Hill for a smack down. Watch. 

youtu.be/1Jiok1sj8KE?...

Can Trump save TikTok? It’s complicated. But here are some options. 

youtu.be/oH-r5ulLDeU?...

TikTok releases statement saying the ARE APPEALING to ask the Supreme Court to strike down the law that will ban the app on January 19th. 
www.youtube.com/watch?v=eIf-...

TikTok CAN be banned. US Appeals Court ruling just issued. Here's what we know. 

www.youtube.com/shorts/2rDCy...

The numbers are in! And they reveal it's going to be much more difficult for House Republicans to jam through Trump's agenda. This video explains the FACTS and the MATH.
www.youtube.com/watch?v=D__1...
It’s ok if he already filed. This case is still ongoing. So it’s MAYBE possible the requirement will come back. We’ll see what happens

Late tonight a federal judge in Texas issued a nationwide preliminary injunction blocking a controversial new reporting requirement due before Jan. 1 for ALL types of business owners in the US. 
Here's what you need to know about the now blocked BOI requirement.
www.youtube.com/watch?v=tIuZ...

The Supreme Court will hear oral arguments in United States vs Skrmetti TOMORROW. This case specifically asks the question, can states ban gender affirming care for minors? 
All you need to know about the case is here. 👇
www.youtube.com/watch?v=eFPZ...

#pressfreedom #media #1stamendment A new report finds freedom of press in the United States is not as free as we think. A new report found when compared to 180 other countries the US doesn’t even rank in the top 50 for press freedom. This video explains where we rank and why our press freedom ranking dropped to the lowest spot since they started keeping track 25 years ago.

#economy #gasprices #costofliving April’s Consumer Sentiment report found a record low. Meaning you feel worse about this economy that at any other point since they started keeping track in the 1950s. Gas prices hit a high we haven’t seen in 4 years and inflation is going up. These are now problems Fed Chair Kevin Warsh will have to deal with. He said today he’s going to be a reformer.

#dni #tulsigabbard #presidenttrump After just 15 months as the Director of National Intelligence, Tulsi Gabbard submitted her letter of resignation to the president this morning. This video explains why she says she has to leave but also examines the visible tension she has had with the president and White House.

#iranwar #presidenttrump #house House Speaker canceled a scheduled vote to rein in President Trump’s ability to continue this war with Iran. The bill was about to pass and instead of letting that happen Speaker Johnson pulled the bill. This video explains what that means.

#presidenttrump #triumphalarch #america250 The Commission of Fine Arts approved President Trump’s *revised* Triumphal Arch. The commission is filled with Trump appointees. The commission released new renderings of what the arch will look like along the Washington DC skyline. This is not done yet. The National Capital Planning Commission will also have to approve this arch. That’s happening next month. But a group of Vietnam vets have sued to stop construction

#immigration #ice #republicans Senate Republicans just derailed their own immigration agenda because of their opposition to the DOJ settlement with President Trump to create the anti weaponization fund. But that’s not all they are opposed to Senate Republicans are also not supporting Trump’s new $1 billion ballroom security funding.

#affordablehousing #congress #buyahouse The House just passed a bill to ban large institutional investors from buying up existing single-family homes. BUT! There are several exceptions. This video explains.

#presidenttrump #irs #doj Democrats, Republicans and even citizens are already trying to stop an unprecedented settlement between the president, his family and his businesses and his own Dept of Justice which includes a $1.77 billion anti-weaponizarion fund and a ban on IRS audits and investigations into past Trump tax returns. Hear how Trump justifies it and how Republicans are responding.

#iranwar #presidenttrump #republicans Senate surprisingly passed a procedural vote to move the War Powers Resolution forward. This may be a big warning for Trump because of which Republicans voted yes. It may be a consequence of him targeting Republican lawmakers he doesn’t like.

#presidenttrump #attorneygeneral  #irs The Dept of Justice quietly announced they had added one more deal to the settlement with President Trump. Today the acting AG said that the IRS will be “forever barred” from auditing and investigating Trump’s previous tax reruns, and the tax returns of his family and his businesses. This video explains what you need to know about that deal and how the Trump administration says about the other settlement which includes an antiweaponization fund.
